label: K-Breathe
description: Displays live breathing data from the Tymewear VitalPro sensor on your Karoo. Includes VE, breathing rate, tidal volume, mobilization index, VE graph, time-in-zones and a power field coloured by your breathing zone, with FIT recording, plus an opt-in Beta that corrects the zones for the strap's day-to-day scale and shows how today compares with your normal.
releaseNotes: Beta rework: zone colours are now corrected for the strap's day-to-day volume scale (learned from the third ride, needs power and heart rate). Vent State shows day quality and the strap scale. New Power + VE zone field: 3s power with a strip in your current breathing zone. Settings can suggest VT1/VT2 changes. Removed: VT1 Power and BR Drift fields. The 0.5.0 baseline is discarded and calibration starts again.
